lines.en: Fixies are such itty -bitty creatures.
lines.zh: 修理工是这样小巧的生物。

lines.en: Even when they're magnified, It's hard to see their features.
lines.zh: 即使放大，也很难看清它们的特征。

lines.en: They're tiny, infinitesimal, so small it makes you doubt.
lines.zh: 它们很小，微乎其微，小到让你怀疑。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密！

lines.en: The Lie Detector
lines.zh: 测谎仪

lines.en: Zimka! Zimka! Shhh!
lines.zh: 辛卡！辛卡！嘘！

lines.en: Quiet! I'm on a stakeout here!
lines.zh: 安静，我在这儿吃牛排呢。哦

lines.en: Who are you staking out? Tom Thomas!
lines.zh: 他被带出来了。汤姆·托马斯

lines.en: We've got a bet that he won't be
lines.zh: 我们打赌他

lines.en: able to survive three days without any TV.
lines.zh: 三天不看电视就活不下去

lines.en: Really? Can I be on the stakeout with you?
lines.zh: 真的，我可以跟你一起蹲点吗？

lines.en: Zimka!
lines.zh: 辛卡

lines.en: Ah -ha! I got you!
lines.zh: 啊哈！逮到你了！

lines.en: What? Who? You lost the bet, Tom Thomas.
lines.zh: 你输了赌局，汤姆·托马斯

lines.en: Just tell me you didn't. I didn't. Why didn't you?
lines.zh: 告诉我你没输。我没有，为什么你没输？

lines.en: It's because I... I'm not Tom Thomas. What?
lines.zh: 因为我……嗯，我不是汤姆·托马斯。什么？

lines.en: I'm Tom's brother. That's totally not true!
lines.zh: 我是汤姆的兄弟。这完全是胡说。

lines.en: We know Tom Thomas doesn't have a brother.
lines.zh: 我们知道汤姆·托马斯没有兄弟。

lines.en: I meant his first cousin.
lines.zh: 我是说他的堂兄弟。

lines.en: Then how come you two look so much alike?
lines.zh: 那你们俩怎么长得这么像？

lines.en: It's cause our mothers are twins.
lines.zh: 因为我们的妈妈是双胞胎。

lines.en: So what should we call you? Who, me?
lines.zh: 那我们该怎么称呼你？我……呃

lines.en: Uh... John Johnson.
lines.zh: 约翰·约翰逊。

lines.en: And who are you, by the way?
lines.zh: 对了，你是谁？

lines.en: As if you don't know who we are.
lines.zh: 好像你不知道我们是谁似的。

lines.en: This room is beautiful. Sure is bigger than mine.
lines.zh: 这房间真漂亮，肯定比我的大。

lines.en: I don't believe you! You're telling a lie!
lines.zh: 我不相信你，你在撒谎。

lines.en: And what is your proof?
lines.zh: 你的证据是什么？

lines.en: Maybe he's not lying.
lines.zh: 也许他没撒谎。

lines.en: There's a way to check it. How?
lines.zh: 有办法验证，怎么做？

lines.en: Yeah, how? With a lie detector, you'll see!
lines.zh: 用测谎仪，你就知道了。

lines.en: A lie detector is a device that is used to help figure
lines.zh: 测谎仪是一种用来帮助确定某人是否在说谎的设备。

lines.en: out if someone is telling the truth or if they are lying.
lines.zh: 他们是在说真话还是在撒谎？

lines.en: You see, when someone is lying they always get a little bit nervous.
lines.zh: 你知道，当有人撒谎时，他们总是会有点紧张

lines.en: Even though we might not see it,
lines.zh: 即使我们可能看不出来。

lines.en: we know that a liar's heart beats a little faster,
lines.zh: 我们知道，说谎者的心跳会加快

lines.en: his breathing changes, and he sweats.
lines.zh: 呼吸会改变，还会出汗。

lines.en: A lie detector can pick up on all of these little things.
lines.zh: 测谎仪可以捕捉到所有这些细微的变化

lines.en: And that's how a lie detector can be used to help find the truth.
lines.zh: 这就是测谎仪如何帮助人们发现真相的原因。

lines.en: But you don't have a lie detector!
lines.zh: 但是你没有测谎仪

lines.en: But we know how a lie detector works, don't we?
lines.zh: 但我们知道测谎仪的工作原理，对吧？

lines.en: Or are you scared, Tom Thomas? What's that for?
lines.zh: 还是你害怕？汤姆·托马斯，那是做什么用的？

lines.en: To listen to your pulse. How come?
lines.zh: 听你的脉搏。为什么？

lines.en: So I'll be able to check how fast your heart is beating.
lines.zh: 这样我就可以检查你的心跳有多快了。

lines.en: And Nolik? He's going to keep an eye on how often you blink.
lines.zh: 诺里克（音乐）他会观察你眨眼的频率。

lines.en: And what are you doing with the egg?
lines.zh: 你拿着鸡蛋干什么？

lines.en: The egg is an old African method.
lines.zh: 鸡蛋是古老的非洲方法。

lines.en: If you're not telling the truth, your hand will automatically squeeze the egg.
lines.zh: 如果你没有说实话，你的手会自动挤压鸡蛋

lines.en: And so, the egg will crack!
lines.zh: 鸡蛋就会裂开。

lines.en: Well, my egg won't crack. We'll see about that.
lines.zh: 我的鸡蛋不会裂开，我们拭目以待。

lines.en: Humans have tried to come up with all
lines.zh: 人类尝试过

lines.en: sorts of ways to find out the truth.
lines.zh: 各种各样的方法来发现真相

lines.en: For instance, in ancient China,
lines.zh: 例如，在中国古代

lines.en: They would put some dry rice in a person's mouth
lines.zh: 人们会在说谎的人嘴里放一些干米。

lines.en: when they told him the crime they believed he committed.
lines.zh: 他们认为他犯了什么罪

lines.en: Then they'd check the rice.
lines.zh: 然后他们检查米粒

lines.en: If the rice stayed dry, they believed he had committed the crime.
lines.zh: 如果米粒保持干燥，他们就认为他犯了罪。

lines.en: In ancient India,
lines.zh: 在古印度

lines.en: a person had to bang on a gong while answering a judge's questions.
lines.zh: 一个人在回答法官的问题时必须敲击神像

lines.en: If he started banging the gong louder,
lines.zh: 如果他敲击枪的声音越来越大

lines.en: then it was believed that he was trying to hide the truth.
lines.zh: 人们就认为他试图掩盖真相。

lines.en: And in Europe, if one night accused another of lying,
lines.zh: 在欧洲，如果一个骑士指控另一个骑士撒谎

lines.en: Then they would just take part in a duel.
lines.zh: 他们就会进行决斗

lines.en: Whoever won that one was said to be on the side of truth.
lines.zh: 谁赢了就被认为是站在真理的一边。

lines.en: No, it's not easy to hide the truth.
lines.zh: 不，掩盖真相并不容易

lines.en: But sometimes it can be even harder to find it.
lines.zh: 但有时找到真相甚至更难。

lines.en: Answer yes or no. You got that?
lines.zh: 回答是或否。你明白了吗？

lines.en: Do you have two ears?
lines.zh: 你有两只耳朵吗？

lines.en: Don't you have eyes? Just yes or no.
lines.zh: 你不建议吗？就回答是或否？

lines.en: Yes. Answer! Are you a girl?
lines.zh: 是。回答：你是女孩吗？

lines.en: Hey, come on! Yes or no? No.
lines.zh: 嘿，拜托，是或否？不。

lines.en: Where do you find such dumb questions?
lines.zh: 你从哪里找到这么愚蠢的问题？

lines.en: We just have to check what happens to
lines.zh: 我们只是想看看当你对我们所有人说实话时

lines.en: your heart when you tell the truth to us.
lines.zh: 你的心会怎么样。

lines.en: Alright, now answer this. Do you know the Fixies?
lines.zh: 好了，现在回答这个问题：你知道固定齿轮乐队吗？

lines.en: Yes or no? Yes. Uh, no!
lines.zh: 是或否？是。呃，不

lines.en: I forgot. His pulse is speeding up.
lines.zh: 我忘了。他的脉搏加快了。

lines.en: Are you Tom Thomas? No.
lines.zh: 你是汤姆·托马斯吗？不。

lines.en: Ah, his pulse is racing! And his eyes have started blinking!
lines.zh: 啊，他的脉搏飞快，他的眼睛开始眨动。

lines.en: And the Fixies, tell us where you learned about him.
lines.zh: 固定齿轮乐队，告诉我们你学到了什么。

lines.en: From Tom Thomas! He couldn't have told you about us!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯说，他不可能告诉你关于我们的事

lines.en: It's a secret! He could! Not true!
lines.zh: 这是个秘密，他不可能。真的吗？

lines.en: It's true! It's not true! Yes it is!
lines.zh: 是真的吗？不是真的吗？是的，是真的。

lines.en: Hey, look! The egg cracked! Just give up, John Johnson!
lines.zh: 嘿，看，蛋裂了，放弃吧，约翰·约翰逊。

lines.en: Alright, I'm Tom Thomas, guys. Tideesh!
lines.zh: 好吧，我是汤姆·托马斯。伙计们

lines.en: Is it really possible to know if you lied just by measuring your pulse?
lines.zh: 真的有可能只通过测量脉搏就能知道你是否撒谎吗？

lines.en: With pulse you really can, but you probably couldn't with the egg.
lines.zh: 确实可以，但你可能做不到。用蛋的话

lines.en: You tricked me then. That wasn't nice.
lines.zh: 你骗了我。那可不好。

lines.en: You weren't tricked! John Johnson was!
lines.zh: 你没被骗，是约翰·约翰逊被骗了。嗯？

lines.en: You know what?
lines.zh: 你知道吗

lines.en: I think you've got to get checked out on this lie detector.
lines.zh: 我觉得你得去接受一下幻灯片检测。

lines.en: I don't think so.
lines.zh: 我不这么认为。

lines.en: You need to get ready to give me my wish.
lines.zh: 你需要准备好满足我的愿望

lines.en: Because you're the one that lost the bet!
lines.zh: 因为你才是输得最惨的人。但如果你需要一张照片，请不要泄露这个秘密。但如果你需要一个固定装置……
